claims.sourceText: UAP Gerb, 'Off-World Technologies Division - UAP Technology Reverse Engineering', published 17 July 2024
claims.text: A US Army Green Beret witness identified as 'RA' states that between 2013 and 2015 he was taken deep underground at a special weapons centre near Crane, Indiana to an 'Off-World Technologies Division' holding a basketball-sized sphere with an indentation and a clear tablet-like device projecting symbology, both described as weapons owing to energetic output when recovered from a craft, and both said to interact with human consciousness.

edges.label: Gerb documented the first-hand witness account
edges.note: Published 17 July 2024 based on witness 'RA', a US Army Green Beret describing an underground division near Crane, Indiana holding two non-human artifacts, 2013-2015.

edges.label: Alleged SAIC and Sandia connections to the division
edges.note: Gerb links the alleged division to SAIC and Sandia National Laboratories; the escorting weapons instructor is described as a private contractor employee.
